title: It Could Happen Here Weekly 256
description:
All of this week's episodes of It Could Happen Here put together in one large file:

  • Israeli Elections and the Palestinians
  • 2026 Elections (The Union Ones)
  • ¡El Chupacabras!
  • Kim Kelly's Morbid Labor Tales 
  • Executive Disorder: Lula’s Victory, AI Election Ads, Voter Fraud, Revolt in Albania
